channel.title: BrownHub Journal
channel.description: Notes on design, print and the web from BrownHub, a graphic design and website studio in Accra, Ghana.

item.title: How to brief a flyer and get it back the same week
item.description: The five things a designer needs before the first layout, and what each one costs you in days when it arrives late.

item.title: We rewrote this site into forty languages by hand
item.description: Why the studio deleted a machine-translation proxy, what it cost, and what a hand-written dictionary actually holds.

item.title: A logo in a week, and what happens on each day
item.description: The six stages the studio runs in a week, laid out day by day, with the decisions that belong to you and the ones that do not.

item.title: What “print-ready” actually means
item.description: Bleed, colour mode, resolution, fonts and the one printed proof — what a printer has to settle before they touch your file.
